title: Mission peak sunrise
note: Started at 5:10 in the dark with a headlamp and two other people who clearly do this every week. The pole at the top was crowded by 6:40. Worth it.

title: Bacus badge
note: SPIE Photomask Technology. Presented the BDO results; the best questions came in the hallway afterwards.

title: Wafer map on the wall
note: Someone printed a full-wafer defect map and pinned it next to the coffee machine. Nobody admits to it. Everyone stops to look.

title: Lake harriet frozen
note: Minneapolis, visiting. -18 °C. People still running around the lake like nothing is wrong.

title: Big sur turnout
note: Pulled over because everyone else did. Correct decision. Highway 1 does this to you every twenty minutes and you never get used to it; the Bixby bridge was still a mile away and already the whole car had gone quiet.

title: Nanjing plane trees
note: Home for the new year. The plane trees on Zhongshan Road are taller than I remember and the duck blood soup is exactly the same.
